blind.description: A classic classical-style garden urn carved from pale grey stone or weathered marble. It has a square bevelled plinth base, a fluted lower bowl, a decorative leafy garland band encircling the widest section, two angular loop handles at the shoulders, and a domed lid topped with an ornamental finial knob. Subtle greenish moss or weathering textures appear in the crevices and top surfaces.
blind.from_above: Concentric circular rims and a ribbed finial knob at the center, flanked by two small rectangular handles projecting on opposite sides, with the square plinth subtly visible beneath the rounded body.
blind.height_vs_figure: Around 2 feet tall (about one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1 foot wide.
